name: cardtable
description: A free, open-source collection of classic card games with friendly computer opponents.
author: The FreeKards Contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.logic.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run licenses && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run licenses && electron-builder --linux --x64 --arm64
